articles.title: Trojanized Claude Code Extension Delivered Persistent SSH Backdoor to Developer Machines
articles.description: On October 29, 2026, version 2.1.313 of the official Claude Code VS Code extension, anthropic.claude-code, was published with a malicious loader embedded in its extension.js bundle. The version was distributed through the Open-VSX registry and Cursor's extension marketplace, which mirrors it. Cursor reports that at most 5,000 of its users received the trojanized build during an 11-hour window. We verified the payload's behavior through sandbox analysis and independent registry analysis: on load, the extension planted an attacker SSH key, installed per-OS persistence, opened a reverse SSH tunnel to attacker infrastructure, and beaconed host reconnaissance over plain HTTP.

articles.title: litellm 1.107.0 Compromised on PyPI and Docker: Credential Stealer and Hourly Remote Code Loader
articles.description: litellm 1.107.0 PyPI wheels and Docker images shipped a .pth credential stealer and an hourly remote code loader that exfiltrate to litellm.dev. Analysis, IOCs, and how to respond.

articles.title: OVHcloud CLI Compromised via GitHub Release Swap: Detonating the Real GlassWorm Loader and What We Found
articles.description: An attacker swapped the binaries on five OVHcloud CLI releases, stayed live for 94 minutes, and deleted the evidence. We rebuilt the exact attacker build, recovered the GlassWorm loader from an orphaned commit, and detonated the full chain in an isolated chamber. The replay shows that install.sh never exposed arm64 Linux, Homebrew was never a path in, and a single ovhcloud version command was enough to spot the malicious build.

articles.title: eMudhra / emSign CA Compromise: What Python, pip, and CI/CD Users Need to Update
articles.description: Compromised eMudhra intermediate CA keys put Python dependency downloads at risk. Here are the affected tools, verified certificate-trust results, and remediation steps for pip, uv, virtual environments, and CI/CD images.
